projectDescription: A drop-in JavaScript comment overlay widget that lets teams click anywhere on a web page to leave anchored comments — complete with automatic screenshots, environment captures, threading, triage, and a built-in inbox.
keyFeatures: Click-anywhere comment anchoring with CSS selector + DOM fingerprint persistence
Automatic viewport screenshots (JPEG) and environment capture (URL, viewport, browser, OS) per comment
Drag-to-select region screenshots attached to comments
Threaded replies with edit, delete, and screenshot attachments
Inbox sidebar with filtering by page, status, type, priority, and tags
Comment triage: type (bug/suggestion/question/improvement), priority (high/medium/low), and free-form tags
Comment lifecycle status: open → in progress → resolved, with resolution time tracking
SPA support via notifyNavigation() and optional autoDetectNavigation
localStorage persistence mode or custom backend callbacks
Agent-ready context block (copy to clipboard for AI coding assistants)
Shadow DOM isolation — widget styles never leak into or from the host page
ESM-only with UMD CDN build, TypeScript definitions included
English and Spanish locales; per-key fallback for partial custom locales
Shareable comment deep links via configurable query parameter
